newsitem.title: USA: Coldwater Creek sets IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Coldwater Creek sets IPO terms.

text.p: Terms for Coldwater Creek Inc's upcoming initial public offering have been set at 2.5 million shares in a price range of $13 to $15 per share, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
No terms were available when the company first filed for the offering in November.
Sandpoint, Idaho-based Coldwater is a specialty direct mail retailer of apparel, gifts and jewelry.
Montgomery Securities is lead underwriter on the deal, which is tentatively scheduled to make its debut at the end of the month under the stock symbol "CWTR".
